payload.rebuttal: argued: _resolve_parents builds a dict only so parent_version_pairs can look names up with parents.get(name); the final order of both pairs and the unreadable list comes entirely from iterating the depends_on argument itself, never from iterating the dict returned by _resolve_parents. Sorting that dict's construction order changes nothing a caller can observe, so no test can distinguish it from the unsorted version, and the probe surviving reflects that this particular line has no behavior to test, not a missing test.
